description:
LANDED 788c0c21f (2026-09-01; refuter FIX-THEN-MERGE, the one required
fix -- a three-path gate fixture for the tail-value arm -- folded plus
doc precision; gate lib 1534/0, cli 24/0, matrix 431/0/9).

Pre-existing three-path-parity break: fz2 interp died 'backend value N
is unbound' on Enum.drop_while([], pred) and killed 00277 after 3 of
its 13 output lines; JIT/AOT correct. TWO distinct sites, both the same
idea (a runtime tolerating an operand the plan proved absent):

(1) CONSTRUCTIONS: demand marks the never-invoked predicate input
ignore -> transport gives it no lane -> no env entry -> but lowering
still emitted the Lambda step reading it as a capture; interp evaluates
steps eagerly and faulted. Fix = shape (a), the preferred direction:
FunctionRef and Lambda go through construction_step_or_omitted like the
other six fresh constructions; a Nothing-layout value lowers Omitted and
is never constructed on ANY path. Native's two duplicated inline proofs
deleted in the same motion (refuter proved the pair atomic: reverting
omission alone turns the new fixture red on all three lanes; a hard
assert re-added at both deleted sites fired 0 times over 578
fixtures x 3 paths).

(2) LANE-LESS RETURNS: main/0#lambda's `tail value v0` where v0 is
demand-ignored and the return contract publishes NO lanes -- native's
return_lane_vars short-circuits without reading; the interp's
BackendTail::Value arm now honors the same proof (env miss on the
returned value = the proof, iff the return publishes no lanes; effects
still run -- eval_steps completes before the tail; any other env miss
still faults). Gated by
fixtures2/behavior/ignored_call_result_lane_less_return (refuter-built,
red on the interp lane with this ticket's signature when the arm is
reverted). Also repairs 00513_spawn_new_fn_resume (refuter-found).

Shape (c) (bind ignored inputs as explicit Absent) MEASURED AND
REJECTED: alone it renames the fault; combined it regresses the working
lane (the interp's closure-call resolution deliberately reads a MISSING
callee entry as omitted-use-direct-target, and an explicit Absent falls
into materialize). Shape (b) not pursued (materializes a dead closure).

Canon: refuter-swept all 450 dumping fixtures -- 6 movers, 16 lines,
every one `vN = lambda ...` -> `omitted vN`; zero other change.
Behavior: 578-fixture sweep, 0 regressions, 3 exit-code repairs (00277,
00513, the new fixture); 00277 all three paths byte-identical at 13
lines. Refuter also proved the misdispatch fear unfounded: an omitted
lambda reaching ClosureCall yields a clean fault, never the
direct-target fallback (7 adversarial shapes constructed, all green).

FOLD CHECK: fz-kdt.3 NOT closed -- its reusable-cons repro is a NATIVE
lowering invariant, byte-identical base vs head (findings recorded in
fz-kdt.3); enum_tier0 stays deferred (fz-bfh.3 halts it first; per-path
failures differ and are recorded there). Residuals ticketed: absence
predicates spelled three ways + missing-entry-vs-Absent dual convention
+ duplicated shape source (fz-kdt.116); three pre-existing parity bugs
found by refuter probes (fz-kdt.117).
title: A closure the plan proves is never invoked is never built: dead constructions omit; lane-less returns read nothing
